detail.longDescription: Use Claude models in Codex and GPT models in Claude Code on your existing plans, routed to whichever has quota left. Weave Router 2.0 routes each coding agent request to the cheapest model that can get it right. On Terminal-Bench 4.0 and SWE-Atlas it matches GPT-6 Astra at half the cost, 2x faster. Powered by a new classifier that scores task complexity and cache-aware switching that only moves when savings beat the rebuild cost.
